text:
Nadia H: PR #488 (migration guide + JS/TS SDK examples) is ready. Vercel preview created but staging shadow preview shows missing hero image and one broken internal anchor. Planning to merge in the Thu maintenance slot 2026-05-05 01:15 UTC unless anyone objects. Can reviewers + infra confirm preview/CI?

Omar F: I can review. Please paste both previews (Vercel + staging shadow). Shadow preview sometimes uses different static roots.

Vercel Bot: [auto] Preview: https://pr-488-docs-redwood.vercel.app 63 status: success. Checks: warning - missing /images/hero.png.

ci-bot: Docs CI: md-lint: pass; linkcheck: broken internal anchor (#upgrade-steps-local). Snippet smoke: TS sample compiles but doesn't export client instance.

Sam T: Local repro steps I left on the PR:
```
git fetch origin pull/488/head:pr/488
git checkout pr/488
npm ci
npm run docs:build # produces site/
python -m http.server --directory site 8080
# open http://localhost:8080 to compare with preview
```
If hero is missing locally check `docs/images/` and mkdocs `docs_dir`/`extra` copy rules. For internal anchors, inspect generated slug in `site/*.html`.

Jules K: Shadow preview (our staging mirror) serves from `/static/` while Vercel uses `/`. That explains the image 404 if the docs reference `/images/hero.png` but shadow expects `/static/images/hero.png`. Recommend using relative paths or ensuring the build copies to both roots.

Infra Bot: Infra suggestion: add `docs/images/hero.png` and rely on mkdocs `extra` to include it in both outputs. For shadow, we also added a rewrite rule in the mirror to accept both `/images/*` and `/static/images/*` but it's brittle.

Nadia H: Pushed branch `fix/hero-and-anchors` copying hero to `docs/images/` and updating the anchor link to `#upgrade-steps` to match generated slug. Also adjusted TS snippet to return `redwoodClient` instance. Redeploying both previews.

Vercel Bot: [auto] Re-deploy finished 63 preview: https://pr-488-docs-redwood.vercel.app 63 status: success. Asset checks: hero resolved.

Shadow Bot: [auto] Shadow preview: https://staging-shadow.redwood.internal/pr-488 63 status: success. Asset checks: hero present under both `/images` and `/static/images`.

Sam T: Reviewed the snippet changes. Left a minor suggestion: show a short example call after client init. Also pasted a short local-checklist for future authors:
1) Run `npm run docs:build` and serve `site/` locally to mirror static output.
2) Check generated slugs in `site/*.html` when linking between pages.
3) Prefer relative paths for images or add copies in `docs/` so both Vercel and shadow mirrors pick them up.
4) Smoke-test code samples in a sandbox (Node/TS).

Jules K: Approved. :white_check_mark: Content and infra changes look good.

Omar F: Approved after the tiny example addition.

Nadia H: Great 63 scheduled merge for 2026-05-05 01:15 UTC maintenance slot. Added release note: "docs: fix hero asset path, correct anchor, and improve TS example". Will merge in window and report back. Closing thread after merge.
